content.short: Global business accounts, FX, payments, cards and embedded finance.
content.description: Airwallex, founded in 2015 in Melbourne and now operating globally from hubs in Australia and Singapore, is a business financial platform built for companies that move money across borders. It offers multi-currency business accounts, local collection accounts in dozens of currencies, competitive foreign-exchange, global pay-ins and payouts, corporate and virtual cards, and expense management. Through its embedded finance and payments APIs, Airwallex also lets platforms and marketplaces offer accounts, cards, and cross-border transfers to their own customers. By replacing a patchwork of correspondent banks with its own global network, Airwallex reduces the cost, delay, and reconciliation complexity of international business payments for startups and enterprises alike.
